notes.title: Wild Animal Improvements
notes.notes:
Wildlife on the island has been improved to provide a more realistic and challenging experience. The following animals have received updates in behavior, animations, or balancing:

Boar

Bear

Crocodile

Goat

Wolf


These changes aim to make interactions with wildlife more immersive, both during exploration and combat.

notes.title: Improved Resource Gathering and Quick Access Toolbar
notes.notes:
This new Roam Survival update brings two key improvements to enhance your island experience:

Resource Gathering Options: You can now choose between using a pointer to collect resources or activating collection by proximity. Customize your gameplay and make exploration more intuitive.

Quick Access Toolbar: We've added a survival-style toolbar so you can quickly and efficiently access essential tools and weapons. Be ready for any situation in an instant!

Explore the island with greater freedom and efficiency in Roam Survival. This update is just the beginning of more improvements to come!

notes.title: Major Update for Roam Survival: Reviving the Adventure in September 2024!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Roam Survival[/b][/h2]

Dear players,

We are proud to announce that in September 2024, we will be launching a groundbreaking update for our game, which will not only mark a new chapter but also rebrand the game as Roam Survival. This update is the result of months of intensive work and dedication to bring you a more immersive and challenging survival experience.

[b][h3]What’s New in Roam Survival?[/h3][/b]

[b]New Main Character:[/b] Our protagonist has been completely redesigned, with new skills and an enhanced appearance that suits the challenges of the revamped world.

[b]Redesigned Maps and Environments:[/b] We have rebuilt the map from the ground up, offering a more vast, detailed world full of mysteries to uncover.

[b]Enemies and Challenges:[/b] Face new enemies and dangers that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you explore the island.

[b]Improved Construction System:[/b] You will now be able to build and customize your shelter with more options and tools than ever before.

[b]Story and Narrative:[/b] The story has been deepened, with new quests, characters, and secrets that will captivate you from the very first moment.

Don’t miss this major update that will redefine your gaming experience in Roam Survival! Mark your calendar for September 2024 and get ready for an epic adventure.

Thank you for being a part of our community and for your continued support!

notes.title: Remake del juego
notes.notes:
Ladies and gentlemen, 

We hope you are well.  

We are pleased to inform you about the recent progress in our project: Since the last update of our video game, we have faced various difficulties in improving it.  A year has passed in which information about the project has been scarce, given that we recently resumed its development due to time limitations as independent developers.  However, we are pleased to inform you that we are working hard on the development of the game and have implemented significant changes, among which are:

[h2]Map renewal: [/h2]
We have redesigned the map to expand its extension and give it a richer tropical atmosphere, increasing the vegetation on the island.  We have more clearly differentiated tropical and rural environments, improved native camps, and incorporated ruins, hanging bridges, cinematics and a greater variety of animals, among other improvements. 

[h2]Improved artificial intelligence: [/h2]
NPCs have been improved to perform more coherent actions during the game, such as hunting with a bow and arrow, collecting animal meat, taking shelter and lighting bonfires at nightfall, as well as dancing around them.  Additionally, we have implemented a noise perception system, which will require the player to maintain stealth around the natives to ensure their survival.  We have also improved the artificial intelligence of the animals. 

[h2]Story development:[/h2] 
We have reorganized the game's plot and are working on the main cinematics, which will include elements of humor and intrigue. The game now has introductions that present the environment and the main and secondary missions in a more coherent and immersive way. 

[h2]Gameplay improvements: [/h2]
We have focused on adapting the controls for those who prefer to use a keyboard or controller.  We have also improved the animations and added the ability for the character to move stealthily, allowing him to run crouched and hide in bushes to avoid detection by NPCs. 

Our goal is to advance and update the game regularly throughout 2024, for example. So we ask for your patience as we work to make the game reach its full potential.  We cannot yet provide an exact date for the first big update, but we will keep you informed. 

Best regards.
